subject: Burst credit basket and true-up path (BrightShop)
messages:
From: Samir Patel <ops@brightshop.com>
To: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Short-term overrun — need help with burst & billing

Hi Neha,

We're seeing a series of minute-level spikes on our search index inference over the last 36 hours — roughly a 6x jump for ~20 minutes each morning. That pushed us through the monthly concurrency threshold and generated a few overrun alerts.

Can Redwood provide a short-term burst buffer/credit while we stabilize? We don't want to accept a massive overrun invoice while our engineers roll out fixes (rate limiting + prefix caching).

Attached is a small usage snapshot and logs that show the burst windows (usage_snapshot_may.zip).

High-level asks:
- Short-term burst credit to cover these microbursts (estimate: up to 1.2M tokens)
- Clarity on how overrun charges would be computed if we don't take a credit
- If possible, a temporary blended overrun rate while we agree a longer commit

Happy to jump on a quick call today.

Thanks —
Samir Patel
Ops Manager, BrightShop
ops@brightshop.com

(attachment: usage_snapshot_may.zip - 1 file stub)

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <ops@brightshop.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Fri, 14 May 2027 10:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Short-term overrun — need help with burst & billing

Hi Samir —

Thanks for the snapshot, that helped. Sorry you're hitting this during launch windows. Short answer: yes, we can help with a temporary burst credit + a blended overrun path while you stabilize.

Next steps I propose:
1) We'll provision a temporary burst bucket (60 days) that can absorb up to 1.2M tokens for your account while you implement the fixes.
2) Ben will send a pricing/credit structure showing the cost of the bucket vs straight overrun charges, and an option where you convert some of that spend into a 3–6 month commit for a discount.
3) Laura (finance) and I will coordinate the PO/invoice path if BrightShop wants a single-line credit applied vs standard per-token billing.

Can you confirm your preferred path (credit vs blended overrun rate) and whether finance can sign a short PO? If a call is easier, I'm free 1–3pm PT today.

Cheers,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

From: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
To: Samir Patel <ops@brightshop.com>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Sat, 15 May 2027 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Short-term overrun — need help with burst & billing

Samir / Neha —

Attached is a quick sketch of two options. High level:
- Option A (Burst Credit): 60-day credit bucket covering up to 1.2M tokens. Redwood will discount the nominal overrun rate by 20% for usage that draws from the bucket. After the bucket is exhausted or the 60 days lapse, normal overrun rates apply.
- Option B (Blended Overrun): Apply a temporary blended overrun rate of $0.045 per 1k tokens for 60 days on incremental usage above your committed threshold. This requires a 3-month minimum conversion of the equivalent amount into a committed slab (we'll convert unused portion to credits).

If BrightShop signs a 6-month commit for 25% of the projected monthly run-rate, we can increase the burst discount to 30% and commit that spend to a slightly lower unit price. This is a standard trade: short-term protection vs longer-term commitment discount.

See burst_offer_v1.pdf attached (contains numbers by token band and an example invoice reconciliation).

Let me know which option you prefer — if you want, we can prepare a one-page MAP and send to finance for a PO.

Best,
Ben Carter
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
ben.carter@redwood.ai
(attachment: burst_offer_v1.pdf - 1 file stub)

From: Elena Morales <finance@brightshop.com>
To: ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>, neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
Date: Mon, 17 May 2027 08:20:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Burst Credit Options — BrightShop PO and discount request

Hi Ben / Neha,

Thanks for the options. A couple of clarifications from finance:
- We need a single-line credit invoice (so it can map to our Q2 contingency budget) rather than many token-line items.
- For any short-term credit we accept, BrightShop requests a 30% discount on what would be the standard overrun charge. We can fast-track a PO if that discount is accepted.

We can commit to a 3-month minimum conversion of 40% of the credited value into committed spend after the 60-day window if that helps balance risk. We prefer that the credit be applied to May invoice month-end.

Please attach a 1-page MSFT-friendly PO intent we can approve internally. I've attached a quick intent file (PO_intent_0427.pdf).

Regards,
Elena Morales
Head of Finance, BrightShop
finance@brightshop.com
(attachment: PO_intent_0427.pdf - 1 file stub)

From: neha_kapoor <neha.kapoor@redwood.ai>
To: Elena Morales <finance@brightshop.com>, ben_carter <ben.carter@redwood.ai>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura.bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 18 May 2027 16:40:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Burst Credit Options — BrightShop PO and discount request

Elena / Ben / Samir —

Appreciate the clarity and the PO intent. We're prepared to accept the fast-track route with a small set of guardrails so both teams have predictability:

Mutual Action Plan (summary):
1) Burst credit bucket: Redwood will provision a 60-day, single-line credit equal to $15,000 that covers up to 1.2M tokens. For accounting simplicity the credit will appear as a single invoice line and will apply to the May invoice.
2) Discount: Redwood will apply a 25% discount to the nominal overrun rate for usage drawn from the credit bucket. (We can't go to 30% at short notice without escalating to finance/legal; 25% is approvable on the spot.)
3) Commit conversion: BrightShop may convert up to 40% of the credited $15k into a 3-month committed slab within 30 days after the 60-day window. If BrightShop signs a 6-month 25% commit within 14 days, Redwood will increase the discount for future overrun protection to 30% (retroactive to unused burst credit amounts).
4) PO and billing: Redwood finance will issue a single-line credit invoice; BrightShop PO intent is acceptable to start. Laura will reach out with the invoice and a short SOW amendment to bind the conversion terms.

We've attached a one-page MAP and the docx SOW (MAP_burst_tier.docx). If that looks good to you, I'll loop in legal for a two-line amendment and send a DocuSign for signature: https://www.docusign.com/BR-2027-burst-MAP

If you accept the 25% immediate discount and the $15k credit, we can have the credit on your account by EOD Wednesday and route the credit invoice to your AP contact for PO matching.

Thanks — we'll keep a close eye on the traffic and provide a post-mortem on the root cause fixes.

Best,
Neha Kapoor
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
neha.kapoor@redwood.ai

(attachment: MAP_burst_tier.docx - 1 file stub)
